topic: Biological variation of fasting glucose
claim: Fasting plasma glucose varies within the same person by about 5-6% between occasions (within-person variability 5.7% for FPG measured 2 to 4 weeks apart), which is why a value near the threshold needs repeating.

notes: At 7.0 mmol/L a 5.7% within-person CV is about +/- 0.4 mmol/L (1 SD). ADA 2026: 'Test results close to the diagnostic threshold should prompt the health care professional to educate the individual about the onset of possible symptoms of hyperglycemia and to repeat the test in 3–6 months.'
